% A \thechapter set in the preamble of a memoir document by a chapter style:
% culver numbers chapters in Roman numerals, with sections within them,
% references with hyperref, the table of contents, and unnumbered
% front-matter and back-matter chapters.
\documentclass{memoir}
\usepackage{hyperref}
\chapterstyle{culver}
\begin{document}
\frontmatter
\chapter{Preface}\label{preface}
Front text.
\tableofcontents*
\mainmatter
\chapter{Start}\label{start}
\section{Basics}\label{basics}
Ref: \ref{start}; \ref{basics}; \ref{second}.
\chapter{Second}\label{second}
Here \ref{second}.
\backmatter
\chapter{Afterword}\label{afterword}
Back text.
\end{document}
